title: Tankers Are Burning in Hormuz Again. In 1987 It Pulled America Into War
description: This week Iran's Revolutionary Guard reported three tankers on fire in the Strait of Hormuz. Almost forty years ago, the same waters saw the Tanker War: Iraq and Iran attacked hundreds of merchant ships, Kuwait put its tankers under the American flag, and the US Navy ended up fighting Iran at sea, then shot down Iran Air Flight 655.
comment_question: Which moment made the war at sea impossible to stop: the Stark, the Bridgeton mine, or Praying Mantis?
